name: Youchan Choi
summary: I research tactile sensors and robotic applications that measure contact force and position. My work covers sensor structures, circuit design, signal processing and experimental evaluation, as well as measurement and control for wearable robots.

education.detail: Robotics Innovatory Laboratory · Prof. Hyouk Ryeol Choi
Intelligent Robotics Laboratory · Prof. Brian Byunghyun Kang

experience.title: Three-axis fingertip tactile sensing
experience.description: Estimated three-axis force and contact position using capacitive sensors, integrated them into a robotic hand, and applied the outputs to grasp control.
experience.status: RA-L manuscript and patent in preparation

experience.title: Wearable hand robot and grasping strategy
experience.description: Contributed to wearable robotic glove research on object properties and fingertip-force estimation. Developed tension/grasp-force measurement devices and actuator control.

experience.title: Wearable robot for flat back syndrome
experience.description: Conducted sensing and control research for a wearable robot to assist posture and movement in people with flat back syndrome.
